author: DTrim99
body:
You're exactly right. For a joint claim you use Schedule 2 (lived with spouse), which gives $479 at household income $2,598; PE is instead applying Schedule 1 (lived alone) and returning $301. The $50 increased excise tax credit is correct, so the refund should be $529, not $351.

Root cause is on our side: the internal flag that selects the "lived with spouse/others" table (`cohabitating_spouses`) was never implemented and defaults to false, so a married-filing-jointly couple is wrongly treated as living alone. This is the same defect you flagged in #983 — already tracked in PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8649 — and this record is another clean example of it. Thanks!
